36074: Erio is Makoto's first cousin. One day, she mysteriously disappeared for six months, with no memory of what happened during that time. At the same time, she began having an extreme fascination with aliens, believing herself to be an alien investigator monitoring humans.
40874: Makoto is a second-year high school student and the protagonist of the story, who transfers into the city after his parents go overseas. He constantly tries to monitor his 'adolescence points', which rise and fall based on his encounters with other girls.
40875: Mifune is Makoto's classmate who is quite friendly with him. Due to the kanji in her name, she is often nicknamed Ryuushi, which she doesn't particularly like. She is vegetarian, referring to herself as a "fruitist" (fruitarian).
40876: Meme is Makoto's aunt and Erio's mother. She also goes under the name Jojo and is an owner of a store that sells sweets. She is cheerful and can often be seen teasing Makoto by attempting to seduce him.
41574: Maekawa is another classmate of Makoto's who is quite tall, always referring to Makoto as 'transfer student' as she can never get his actual name right. She gets dizzy if she raises her arms over her head for more than ten seconds, and often wears various costumes.
43347: A white-haired girl who claims to be an alien esper, often wearing a spacesuit and occasionally talking in a silly alien-like manner. She is rumored to be a troublesome runaway.
43926: Hanazawa is the pitcher of the city's softball team. She's going out with one of her teammates. Hanazawa and her boyfriend attend the same high school as Makoto.
44136: The boy Meme Touwa met when they were kids, who would eventually become Erio's father.
